purpose: Audit the current BRTI kernel's binary-settlement calibration using authoritative CF history, while keeping direction pricing separate from execution/completion.

download.storage: Deterministic gzip of each successful raw Kalshi envelope, mtime=0; receipt stores HTTP/body/payload hashes and timestamp range but no values.

hard_guards: Never issue a history request whose timestamp is 2026-07-23 or later.
Reject and do not persist any response containing a value timestamp outside its requested half-open UTC day [start,start+24h).
Never call recent /cfbenchmarks/values as a substitute.
Never print or persist credentials, signatures, auth timestamps, private-key paths, or individual BRTI values in console/receipt.
Each successful day response must contain at least one validated BRTI row; an empty day is an acquisition failure.
If any of the three downloads fails validation, calibration is NO_DECISION; do not fill gaps with Coinbase, market mid, later capture, interpolation, or terminal settlement.

kernel.source: Current tools/research/crypto_mm/rti_pricing.py plus mm_engine pricing_state contract, embedded in sealed analyzer.
kernel.tick_selection: At target close-horizon, use latest authoritative BRTI source tick at or before target-2s. This conservative lag avoids treating an exactly timestamped historical tick as instantaneously received.
kernel.sigma60: Non-demeaned timestamp-aware diffusion over strict trailing 60s.
kernel.sigma300: Non-demeaned timestamp-aware diffusion over strict trailing 300s.

settlement_and_metadata.crosscheck: Require exactly 60 authoritative one-second BRTI values in [close-60s,close), compute their mean, and require (mean>=floor_strike) to equal official result. Otherwise exclude and report.

market_mid_benchmark.reconstruction: A snapshot replaces both maps; ordered deltas add signed delta_e4 at exact side/price.
market_mid_benchmark.validity: Any missing receive clock, delta before an initial snapshot, unknown side/update semantics, or negative displayed quantity invalidates that market-day. Never clamp.
market_mid_benchmark.sampling: At each fixed forecast target, use the latest reconstructed two-sided book with recv_wall_ns <= target wall-clock ns.
market_mid_benchmark.yes_mid: (best positive YES bid + (1-best positive NO bid))/2.

primary_metrics.unit: One row per settled market per fixed horizon.
metrics: calibration intercept and slope from logit(P(Y=1))=a+b*logit(forecast)
paired kernel-minus-market Brier and log-loss differences
primary_metrics.uncertainty: Market-cluster bootstrap, 2000 replicates, seed 26072611, percentile 95% CI.
primary_metrics.minimum_reportable: At least 20 unique markets and both outcomes; otherwise descriptive only.

fair_mid_gap_to_future_mid.reason: Historical CF rows contain source time/value but not the original Kalshi receipt clock. A 1/2/5/10s causal microstructure markout cannot mix BRTI source time with book receive time.

p3_first_fill_oof.reason: The existing P3 artifact was built on the superseded ts_utc/ws_seq replay, its first_ts is not a corrected receive-clock fill timestamp, and it lacks first_side/first_price. It will not be joined.

explicitly_blocked_secondary_tests.required_future_contract: Rebuild both books and trades in a common receive-clock domain, preserve per-episode first side/price/receive timestamp, and seal a separate grouped-OOF preregistration.

interpretation.calibration: Answers whether the BRTI kernel's direction probabilities match binary outcomes and how its score compares with market mid.
interpretation.execution_completion: Queue position, fill toxicity, opposite-leg completion, fees, and forced exits are not identified by calibration.
interpretation.decision_rule: Do not infer execution viability from good calibration; do not infer bad calibration from negative MM PnL.
interpretation.deployment: No result here authorizes trading or parameter changes.
